request_summary: Run the GEC suite on DEV under the approved plan with a direct-report failure policy.

actions.description: Ran the approved behave command once (interpreter 3.14.3, TARGET_ENV=dev, suite=gec); before_all aborted on an unresolved Key Vault secret, so no scenario ran. Reported blocked with counts, exit code, artifact paths and tested working-tree state.
The orchestrator checked the runner result against the repository history: the secret reference was introduced by an earlier commit that replaced a hardcoded table endpoint.

outcome.detail: The runner followed the approved plan and reported the blocker accurately; no test result exists because the DEV secret is not provisioned.

friction.description: The runner added a console log capture to the approved command; it was disclosed and had no effect on the run.
